name: AFM level 2 task 7: Load-Dependent Average Friction
description: Acquire exactly three contact-mode lateral-force images at the same location using setpoints of 0.1 V, 0.2 V, and 0.3 V, in that order. Keep the scan size at $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$, resolution at $256 \times 256$ pixels, time per line at 0.075 s, and P/I/D gains at 100/50/0. Calculate the average friction. Report all friction-signal values, in volts ($\pu{V}$) from the lateral channel.
submission_format: {"average_friction_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "average_friction_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_2": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "average_friction_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_3": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"average_friction_1": "0.12", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid", "average_friction_2": "0.15", "path_2": "/results/afm_images/image2.nid", "average_friction_3": "0.18", "path_3": "/results/afm_images/image3.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Suffixes _1, _2, and _3 identify the first, second, and third acquisitions in the order specified in the question; use a separate raw .nid file for each. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. Friction-signal values must be in V, not N.
